extract_text_from_a2a_message: extract text content from an A2A message dict or object containing parts with text kind
extract_text_from_a2a_response: extract text content from an A2A response dict by navigating result and message fields
calculate_usage_from_request_response: calculate prompt, completion, and total token usage from an A2A request and response dict
count_tokens: count tokens in a text string using litellm token counter with fallback to zero
get_input_message_from_request: extract the input message object from an A2A SendMessageRequest or SendStreamingMessageRequest
